headline: IG Metall Initiates 24-Hour Warning Strikes Across German Industrial Sector
summary: German industrial trade union IG Metall commenced 24-hour warning strikes affecting factories nationwide across the metalworking and electrical engineering industries.
why: IG Metall is Europe's largest industrial union. Work stoppages across German manufacturing affect global automotive and industrial machinery output.

impacts.name: Germany
impacts.why: Industrial strikes temporarily halt production lines in key manufacturing export sectors.
